subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: The `options` object passed to `contentstack.Stack(options)` does NOT include a `live_preview` configuration block. The prescribed root-cause fix requires adding `live_preview: { enable: true, management_token: CONTENTSTACK_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN }` (conditionally spread) so the Contentstack SDK polls/receives preview updates. Without this, the SDK never processes live preview data and every downstream consumer is starved of preview content. Confirmed by reading the file — options contains only api_key, delivery_token, environment, branch, and fetchOptions. A search for `live_preview` across the entire codebase returned zero matches.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a `live_preview` block to the Stack options: `...(CONTENTSTACK_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN ? { live_preview: { management_token: CONTENTSTACK_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN, enable: true } } : {})`. Read CONTENTSTACK_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN from process.env alongside the other env vars.

issues.description: `useContent` calls `useContext(ContentstackContext)` but there is no reactive Provider component supplying a changing value. The hook will always return the static SSR-provided default content. Even if Contentstack live preview events fired, there is no state setter to trigger re-renders of the 236+ consumers. The hook cannot propagate live preview updates as-is. Confirmed by reading the file — it imports from `context/contentstackContext` and uses `useContext` with no reactive source.
issues.suggestedFix: Create a `ContentstackProvider` component that wraps `useState(defaultContent)` and a `useEffect` subscribing to Contentstack Live Preview SDK's `onEntryChange` callback, calling `setContent(livePreviewData)` on each event. Wrap the app with this Provider so `useContext` returns reactive state.

issues.description: The prescribed fix requires a `ContentstackProvider` component with `useState(defaultContent)` + `useEffect` subscribing to `onEntryChange`. The file does not exist at `src/context/ContentstackContext.tsx`. The actual context file (`contentstackContext`) exports a bare `createContext` with no Provider, no `useState`, no `useEffect`, and no `onEntryChange` subscription. A search for `onEntryChange`, `onLiveUpdate`, `LivePreview`, and `live-preview-utils` across the entire `src/` directory returned zero matches. Without a reactive Provider, none of the five acceptance criteria related to real-time content display can be met.
issues.suggestedFix: Implement the ContentstackProvider as prescribed: `const [content, setContent] = useState(defaultContent); useEffect(() => { onEntryChange(() => setContent(livePreviewData)); }, []);` Export both the context and the Provider component.

issues.description: The `@contentstack/live-preview-utils` dependency is not installed anywhere in the project. A search for `live-preview-utils`, `livePreviewUtils`, and `onEntryChange` across the entire project returned zero matches. Without this SDK, no client-side WebSocket-based Live Preview subscription can be established, making real-time content updates impossible.
issues.suggestedFix: Add `@contentstack/live-preview-utils` to package.json dependencies and import its `onEntryChange` (or equivalent) in the ContentstackProvider to subscribe to preview update events.

issues.description: No vitest unit tests exist for the Live Preview feature. The `test/unit/` directory does not exist. Review criteria require new features to have corresponding vitest unit tests mirroring the src/ path. At minimum, tests should verify: (1) Stack options include a `live_preview` block with `enable: true` and `management_token`, (2) ContentstackProvider re-renders consumers when `onEntryChange` fires, (3) content state merges incoming preview data correctly, (4) the page renders published content when Live Preview is not active.
issues.suggestedFix: Create `test/unit/context/ContentstackContext.test.tsx` and `test/unit/services/contentstack.test.ts` with vitest tests covering the scenarios above. Ensure the total test count does not decrease.

issues.description: The diff does not address the prescribed root cause. The GIT DIFF contains only `.epam/codeline-facts.json` and `.epam/settings.json` — tooling config files. None of the four relevant source files (src/context/ContentstackContext.tsx, src/hooks/useContent.ts, src/services/contentstack.ts, src/interface/content/contentCard.ts) were modified. git_state confirms the working tree is clean with no changed files. The prescribed minimal fix — replacing the static useMemo with useState + useEffect subscribing to onEntryChange, and adding live_preview config to the Stack initialization — was not implemented at all.
issues.suggestedFix: Implement the prescribed minimal fix: (1) Add `live_preview: { management_token, enable: true }` to the Stack options in src/services/contentstack.ts, (2) Create a ContentstackProvider with useState + useEffect + onEntryChange subscription in src/context/ContentstackContext.tsx, (3) Add corresponding vitest unit tests.
